data.narrative: Alekhya demonstrated exemplary technical leadership in Module 01, establishing a rigorous engineering mindset for AI-augmented workflows. She correctly selected Option B (Task-by-Task delegation) to prevent cascading errors, set up the TaskFlow API starter workspace with automated Node.js tests, authored a comprehensive architecture and extension summary, and executed targeted CLI commands to disprove a false claim regarding workspace completeness. Her trust calibration audit establishes a sound foundation for multi-agent feature engineering.

dimension_scores.observation: Rigorously spot-checked agent claims using independent automated commands rather than accepting plausible conversational statements.
dimension_scores.evidence: Executed node evaluation scripts against src/routes/index.js and src/models/store.js, logging 100% empirical verification in progress/trust-audit.md.

dimension_scores.evidence: Identified failure mechanism in Step 6 FIX and provided constrained prompt template targeting src/ and tests/ entry points.

dimension_scores.observation: Demonstrated sound engineering leadership by treating the AI agent as a 'capable intern' whose outputs must be grounded against production contracts.
dimension_scores.evidence: Articulated trust model: trust factual syntax claims anchored in files; verify behavioral, architectural, and security claims with CLI tests.

dimension_scores.observation: Delivered production-ready artifacts: green automated starter test suite, complete architecture summary, and empirical trust audit log.

strengths: Hypothesis-driven trust calibration: verifies agent claims against ground truth CLI output rather than conversational consensus.

Clear boundary enforcement: recognizes that human engineers maintain ultimate responsibility for shipped production code.
